name: Inspection steward
design: Very broad muscular male with dark yellow-green hide, blunt exposed mandibles and a scarred wide brow, cropped thick dreadlocks. Heavy worn black leather front apron over ochre short-sleeve work tunic, bronze utility buckles, thick wrist wraps, dark knee pads. Holds a compact closed caliper-shaped inspection tool at waist and a small unmarked equipment tag plate. Relaxed work pose, no combat armor.
